parameters.query: WITH a AS (UPDATE soins.alarmes SET statut = 'acquittee', acquittee_le = now() WHERE $1 <> '' AND id = NULLIF($1, '')::uuid AND statut = 'nouvelle' RETURNING id) SELECT id, recue_le, chambre, type, libelle, faits, contexte, statut, acquittee_le FROM soins.alarmes WHERE ((statut = 'nouvelle' AND recue_le > now() - interval '12 hours') OR ($2 = 'true' AND recue_le > now() - interval '24 hours')) AND id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM a) UNION ALL SELECT id, recue_le, chambre, type, libelle, faits, contexte, 'acquittee', acquittee_le FROM soins.alarmes WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM a) AND $2 = 'true' ORDER BY recue_le DESC LIMIT 40
SELECT s.identifiant, g.nom, s.jeton_hash FROM soins.sessions s JOIN soins.soignants g ON g.identifiant = s.identifiant WHERE s.jeton_hash = $1 AND s.expire_le > now() AND g.actif
